title: Q-SPEC-14-KIT-SLOT: the kit's Worker runs at most one tick per slot (US-14-R03, US-14-R09)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** specification audit 2026-11-26 (specs/ against the code)
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q sched_slots -- seed/worker/src
**Status:** open

`workers/adapters/shared/slot.js` (`runOncePerSlot`, table `sched_slots`) deduplicates a scheduler that delivers twice, and both reference handlers use it. The kit's Worker (`seed/worker/src/index.js` scheduled handler) does not: two cron deliveries in one slot run two ticks. Add the slot guard to the kit's scheduled path only (the second producer `POST /pulse/watch` must still be able to run a tick when the heartbeat is stale, and the standby slot of the cutover must be unaffected), create the table through the kit's own schema path, and test it in `seed/worker/test/tick.test.js` or a new test: the same slot twice gives one `tick_runs` row. Then set the row in `specs/US-SPEC-14-portability-seams.md` to BUILT.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `node seed/worker/test/run.mjs`
**Prediction:** duplicate_ticks_per_slot <= 0 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** changing the tick interval; deduplicating the watchdog's own restart tick; any tenant-specific code in the kit.
